spec.title: Pairs marked at each pass
spec.aria: A table showing pairs marked in each pass of the table-filling algorithm: Pass 0 marks q0q1, q0q2, q1q3, q2q3; Pass 1 marks q1q2 (highlighted); Pass 2 marks none (shown grey), so the algorithm stops.
